subject: Mentors needed for Optimal Control Project

messages.subject: Mentors needed for Optimal Control Project
parts:
Hi All,

I am proposing the project: Optimal Control for this summer.
Last year a Control Systems Toolbox was released as part of GSoC 2017 and the CVXR optimization package
also appeared on CRAN last year.
For this year, I am proposing on using the CVXR modeling package to provide optimal control functionality
for the R Community. Generally, bringing optimization to parts of  control systems.
MATLAB and Python have tools for this purpose, but this is not available in R yet.

Optimal Control has a wide range of applications in life sciences, systems biology, finance, engineering,
supply chain management, aerospace studies, missile systems, etc. See a good list of some application areas and 
samples from PROPT in MATLAB: http://tomdyn.com/matlab_optimal_control_examples.html

The idea page is here: https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2018/wiki/Optimal-Control

So, I'm looking out for interested mentors. 

Thank you

Best,
Ben Ubah
